science_sections.why: The main belt: ~1–2 million bodies between Mars and Jupiter, total mass ≈ 4 % of the Moon. Jupiter's resonances cleared the belt — fragmentation has won against accretion ever since.
The belt occupies the 2.2–3.2 AU annulus. Kirkwood gaps — empty orbit zones at Jupiter mean-motion resonances — pattern the population.
Most belt asteroids stay near the ecliptic (< 10° inclination) but the high-inclination Pallas family at 33° reminds you the belt is a 3-D disc, not a 2-D ring.
